value_definitions.auxiliary_supervision: An additional target supplies a supervised loss.
value_definitions.contrastive_supervision: An additional contrastive relation supplies a loss.

components.absence_rule: Use absent only after reviewing all relevant paths and establishing that this role is not instantiated. Missing evidence is never absent.
components.description: Transformation of targets supplied to the base loss.
components.excludes: Input augmentation and numerical smoothing strength.
components.multi_mechanism_rule: Collapse equivalent observations. Split distinct roles or define precise structural composition in a schema extension. Never concatenate labels or pick a primary winner.
components.numeric_invariants: Dimensions, widths, counts, ranks, rates, thresholds and coefficient values stay in evidence, never labels or spelled-out numbers. A change in an executed mechanism needs its own source-based role decision.
components.scope: Transformation of targets supplied to the base loss.

value_definitions.absent: This role is not instantiated on any relevant reachable path.
value_definitions.label_smoothing: Categorical target distributions are smoothed before the loss.

review_policy.alias_scope: Aliases apply only after source dataflow establishes the role and operator semantics. API spelling alone is insufficient.
review_policy.classification_unit: A semantic mechanism at a specified computational role, never a bag of API names.
review_policy.multiple_mechanisms: Collapse equivalent observations. Split distinct roles or define precise structural composition in a schema extension. Never concatenate labels or pick a primary winner.
review_policy.numeric_rule: Dimensions, widths, counts, ranks, rates, thresholds and coefficient values stay in evidence, never labels or spelled-out numbers. A change in an executed mechanism needs its own source-based role decision.
review_policy.ownership: Each semantic fact has one component owner. Distinct aspects of an operation may have separate owners with separate evidence.
review_policy.provisional_values: Draft broad labels explicitly listed as provisional cannot be published. Replace with precise categories or factor out the missing semantic aspect, and reproject all candidates.
